}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale (NXP)]] i.MX7D (MCIMX7D5EVM10SD) [[ARM]] :@1.0GHz Dual Core (Cortex-A7)/@200MHz (Cortex-M4) *Storage: 16MB SPI (NOR), 8GB (eMMC) flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: [[ISSI]] 2GB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Network: 2x 1GbE ports *USB: 1x USB 2.0 port *Other: 2x RS485 (DE9) ports, 1x CAN (DE9) port *Power Source: 8-18V/3A via barrel
